CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Payment methods are loaded and visible on the payment step
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open payment step in checkout and confirm method list after page load.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Payment methods list is fetched and displayed on the payment page.
List is visible without broken or empty controls.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: User can select a payment method via radio button and selection persists after reload
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Select Credit Card, refresh the page, and revisit payment step.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Selected payment option is marked correctly after reload.
Selection control remains usable and consistent.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Adyen credit card form displays when Credit Card is selected
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Choose Credit Card and inspect presence of required fields.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Credit card form appears with cardholder, card number, expiry, and CVV fields.
Form layout is readable and interactive.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Proceed action validates card data and shows field-level errors for invalid input
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Enter invalid card values and attempt to proceed.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Validation blocks progression on invalid card details.
Error messages are displayed near the relevant field block.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Billing address is shown as selected and matches shipping address
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Submit packaging step and inspect billing address area on payment page.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Billing address appears selected by default.
Displayed billing address matches the submitted shipping address.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Billing address section respects critical-path restrictions
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Check billing section controls and interactions on payment page.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Country switch is not enabled.
Billing address cannot be edited in this critical-path scope.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Retry page and skeleton states are handled correctly
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Observe initial loading and simulate query failure path where possible.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Skeleton is shown during loading.
Retry page is shown when payments page query fails.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Selected payment method is submitted through ChooseCartPaymentMethodMutation
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Select Credit Card and inspect network call when submitting payment selection.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Mutation for choosing cart payment method is triggered on submit action.
Selected payment option is reflected in request behavior.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: MRP credit card form styling matches approved design
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open MRP payment step on desktop and mobile widths and compare with design baseline.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Credit card form styling aligns with MRP design intent.
No visible style regression reduces trust or readability.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Critical payment path works consistently across desktop and mobile
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Repeat core checks on desktop and mobile viewport/device setup in acceptance.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Core payment method and billing behaviors are consistent across device types.
No device-specific blocker prevents critical-path completion to payment selection stage.
